# Scratch & Roam with Natali

> First-timer China travel guides and videos from Natali, a maker based in Ireland. Every guide is written from first-hand experience, dated and rechecked, and pairs a YouTube video with step by step answers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://scratchandroam.com/): newest videos and the questions first-time visitors ask
- [China guides](https://scratchandroam.com/china/): every guide, grouped by before you fly, at the border, and once you are there
- [About](https://scratchandroam.com/about/): who Natali is and how the guides are made

## Guides

- [Alipay metro QR code in China: how to add it](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/alipay-metro-qr-code-china/): How to add the Alipay metro and bus QR code for China: pick the city, claim the free card, enter your payment password, and fix the wrong-city code.
- [Build Spice Tolerance Before China: 6 Week Plan](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/build-spice-tolerance-before-china/): How to build spice tolerance before China: why mala burns and numbs, a 6 week plan, what actually cools the heat, and how to order mild in Chinese.
- [China arrival card in Alipay: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-arrival-card-alipay/): Filling in the China arrival card online with Alipay on your phone? Here is the whole form step by step. Upload your passport and most of the details fill in for you.
- [China arrival card on a PC: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-arrival-card-pc/): Filling in the China arrival card online on a computer? Here is the whole form step by step, with the real form enlarged. Upload your passport and most of the details fill in for you.
- [China do's and don'ts: 15 rules before you fly (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-dos-and-donts/): China do's and don'ts for first-timers: what customs and airport security take off you, the table manners that get stares, and what to pack or just buy there.
- [China first trip checklist: safety and backups (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-before-you-fly-checklist/): The safety and backup side of a first China trip: insurance, your hotel in Chinese, emergency numbers, phone and data, payments, document copies, scams, a medical kit, maps and day one.
- [China travel apps: 12 to set up before you go (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-travel-apps/): The China travel apps to set up before you fly: paying, maps, taxis and trains, what must be done at home, the extras already inside Alipay, and what to skip.
- [China Visa Free 30 Days: Irish, UK and EU Passports](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-visa-free-30-days/): Who gets 30 days visa free in China right now, until when, what to show at the border, and whether you can extend or leave and come back. Checked 17 October 2026.
- [First time in China: 13 things to set up before you fly](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/first-time-in-china/): Going to China for the first time? The 13 things we set up before flying: entry rules, the arrival card, Alipay and WeChat, cards, cash, flights, trains, maps and packing.
- [How to Order Food in China Without Speaking Chinese](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/how-to-order-food-in-china-without-speaking-chinese/): How to order food in China without speaking Chinese: phrases to point at, scan-to-order menus, night market and street stall ordering, and how to pay.
- [How to order on Taobao as a foreigner: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/taobao-for-foreigners/): How to order on Taobao without speaking Chinese: language and currency settings, searching in English, hotel delivery, the Chinese note, and paying with Alipay.
- [Huangpu River night cruise Shanghai: pier, ticket, time](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/huangpu-river-night-cruise/): Three piers, three cruise lengths, about 120 to 150 RMB for the standard night cruise. How to book as a foreigner, why your passport matters, and which side of the boat to stand on.
- [Nanjing Road Shanghai: metro exit, neon times and the walk](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/nanjing-road-shanghai/): Nanjing Road pedestrian street: 1.6 km from People's Square to the Bund, metro exits at each end, neon on from 18:00 or 19:00 until 22:00, and the walk that ends at the river.
- [Shanghai Circus World ERA show: tickets and how to get there](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/shanghai-circus-world-era-show/): ERA at Shanghai Circus World: metro Line 1 to Shanghai Circus World station exit 3, shows at 19:30 Tuesday to Sunday, ticket zones from about 280 to 880 RMB, and where foreigners can book.
- [The Bund Shanghai at night: how to get there and when to go](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/the-bund-shanghai-at-night/): How to get to the Bund by metro (East Nanjing Road, exit 2 or 7), the best time for the lights, when they switch off, and a simple route along the river. Free, no ticket.
- [Top 25 China apps for tourists, ranked (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/top-25-china-apps/): The 25 apps worth having for a trip to China, ranked from critical to optional: what each does, how to set it up, what you lose without it. Checked October 2026.
